newsitem.title: USA: NYSE March short interest rises 162.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: NYSE March short interest rises 162.5 mln shares.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Thursday that short interest rose to an all time high of 3,099,416,910 shares in the month ended March 14.

This was an increase of 162,454,534 shares from the total of 2,936,962,376 shares reported a month ago. The exchange reports short interest, an indicator of investors that expect stock prices to fall, on a monthly basis.
